svg.aria-label: Three versions of the same made-up floor plan with lights around its walls: a sweep crossing the house, a build closing in toward the middle, and two rooms trading the lead.

g.text: A bright band crosses from room to
room, because it knows where lights stand.
A build closes in around you
Each snare lights stretches closer to the
middle, all meeting there as the build ends.
The rooms at each end take a color
and trade the lead, phrase by phrase.
